newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Luxembourg 1997 OLUX funding fixed at 4 bln Lfr.
newsitem.headline: Luxembourg 1997 OLUX funding fixed at 4 bln Lfr.

text.p: Luxembourg's Treasury has been authorised to raise four billion francs in 1997 through its OLUX bond auctions, according to a law adopted earlier this month, a copy of which was obtained by Reuters on Monday.
The Treasury has so far raised 1.985 billion francs from the issue of its new 10-year, 5.5 percent bond maturing May 2007. The next auction has been set for September 18.
Luxembourg, which has hardly any debt, only issues OLUX to fulfil the Maastricht Treaty single currency criterion on long-term interest rates.
The law, which entered into force on June 16, also sets out Luxembourg's ambition to convert all outstanding OLUX to euro once European economic and monetary union (EMU) starts.
Other countries have also pledged to convert their debt to euros, but the law makes Luxembourg the first to actually adopt legislation enforcing such a change.
